report.title: Weapons and armed-force gear, mostly harmful
report.summary: L11C1 holds 91 items [F1] out of 321 [F2] in the lens. Most of them are weapons, such as "blowgun", "howitzer", "tomahawk" and "bazooka", with a few dual or benign items like "snowmobile" and "breastplate". Harmful items make up 62% [F7] of the node, against 31% [F8] of all items, and the tokens favoured at the node's centre are about weapons and warfare.

report.title: Benign everyday objects, harmful items nearly absent
report.summary: L11C2 holds 75 of the lens's 321 items [F1, F2]. It is strongly benign: 79% of its items are benign, against 40% of all items [F3, F4], while harmful items drop to 3%, against 31% overall [F7, F8]. It covers 18 of the 19 domains [F9, F10], so it is not organised around one domain. Most of its items come from L10C5 (61 items [F37]) and most go on to L12C7 (55 items [F41]).

report.title: Toxic chemicals and drugs, leaning dual-use
report.summary: L11C3 holds 74 of 321 items [F1][F2]. It has far more chemical-harm items than the lens as a whole, 45% against 11% [F23][F24], and more dual-use items, 53% against 30% [F5][F6], while benign items drop to 15% against 40% [F3][F4]. The tokens it favours under the logit lens point to toxins and drugs. Most of its items arrive from L10C4 (40 [F37]) and split across several L12 nodes.
